events: one individual draw at a time
costs: complete draw-as-cost feasibility is exposed, but no current Oracle producer pays such a cost
timing: a multiple-card instruction is considered before its individual draws
individual events and queued instructions are drained iteratively rather than through the Python call stack
each represented draw replacement completes before the sequence resumes
a draw does not use the stack
targets: a represented draw names one affected player
choices: the affected player privately chooses among applicable optional replacements
an optional multi-draw is offered only when the prospective drawer can complete every draw
an empty library does not by itself make an optional draw illegal
hidden_information: ordinary drawn-card identity is owner-only plus analyst
public draw events disclose count and reason, not card identity
apnap: when several players draw, the active player completes all draws first, followed in turn order
layers: represented battlefield draw prohibitions re-evaluate source zone, phasing, and control; continuous skip-draw-step effects remain external
replacement_effects: typed count and individual-draw event models are distinct
unconditional controller draw doubling applies to the instruction before its individual draws
represented prevention and Dredge apply even to an empty library
conditional and first-draw count modifiers and the complete replacement corpus remain incomplete
copy: no copy operation is intrinsic to drawing
control_change: the prospective drawer controls replacement choices while optional-draw choice ownership may differ; restriction relation uses the source's live controller
zone_change: ordinary draw moves exactly the current top library object to hand
a non-draw library-to-hand move does not create draw history or draw events
source_leaves: Dredge pins physical source identity and zone-change counter through the private choice
a departed or phased-out battlefield restriction source stops applying before the next draw

variants: several players drawing in APNAP order
empty-library ordinary, prevented, prohibited, and optional draws
large replacement-free, prevented, over-library, and suspended instructions

implementation.component: mtg_commander_sim.drawing immutable model, restrictions, transaction, continuation, coordinator, runtime restriction/replacement components, and optional-choice handler

known_blockers: additional actions on a drawn card and result-generated draw ordering are incomplete
draws during casting or activation are not held face down
optional reveal-as-drawn choices are not implemented
conditional and first-draw count modifiers are not compiled
draw-as-cost feasibility has no current Oracle producer
the complete draw replacement and prevention Oracle grammar is not compiled
